name: web
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project web --web

targets.// ports: Pinned explicitly because `next dev` and `next start` both honour the ambient PORT variable. The API also needs a port, and a shared PORT means whichever app starts second dies with EADDRINUSE. Passing --port here makes the web app ignore PORT entirely.

test.// passWithNoTests: The constitution requires unit tests for domain logic, which lives in libs/shared/domain. UI-only changes do not, so an empty web suite is a pass rather than a failure.
